summary: @ornikar/babel-preset-base preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares itself as a Babel preset (index.js returns a preset-env config) but ships a preinstall hook (`package.json` scripts.preinstall: `node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<pm>.zip`, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle with a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, string-array rotation (`function WV8StW(...) { M.push(M.shift()); }`), a 1000+ entry mixed hex/string constant table `n7gIxM`, and `_0xXXXX`-style identifiers throughout. A Babel preset has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or to ship a heavily obfuscated sibling bundle unrelated to Babel configuration. The preinstall hook fires automatically on `npm install`, running the obfuscated payload under Bun on the installer host with no user consent, and the alternate-runtime execution path bypasses Node-based static analyzers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
